title: Reef Bleaching Returns Faster Than Coral Recovery
hook: New bleaching arrives while the last reef recovery is unfinished.
closing: Repeated bleaching matters because each early return interrupts the reef's recovery.
question: Can the reef recover fast enough?

segments.say: The Great Barrier Reef has bleached three times this decade. A rare shock became recurring damage.
The average bleaching gap since 2020 is two years. New damage now returns quickly.
A reef typically needs ten years to recover. Bleaching returns long before that recovery can finish.
